description: PRA shapefile safran grid is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Philippe Estival. Grille Safran (8x8km) des Petites Régions Agricoles (PRA) Vincent Douzal, Guy Michel, Draaf SRISE, agriculture régionale Paca, Philippe Estival, Cartodébat SAS;. Coverage: Philippe Estival. The publisher named on the listing is Philippe Estival. Its keywords include agriculture-zonages-agricoles, safran. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2025-12-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
